balls.text: In the air.... dropped! Suryavanshi runs back from short third, dives but fails to hang on. Shashank once again looks to play the scoop and gets across early, it was the slower length ball and he gets a top edge to it but gets away. PBKS finish with 219 for 5

Finally gets one away. Shashank moves across early, stays still for the yorker - or the full toss if the bowler misses his mark. He gets a low full toss that he manages to scoop just wide of short fine leg

Superb effort by deep backward point. Deshpande aims full and wide outside off, Shashank gets across and opens the face of the bat as he squeezes it through backward point. Maphaka's effort in the deep keeps it down to two
Low full toss outside off, Shashank moves across and wrists it away through midwicket. Takes a couple to bring up a 27-ball fifty
Nails the yorker, just inside the tramline. Shashank moves across to dig it away but doesn't make contact
Now goes for the wide line but misses it
In the slot, out of the park. Deshpande has been good with the yorkers, aims for it but just misses the mark. Lands it in Shashank's slot and it is despatches over long-on
Yorker just inside the wide tramline, he goes hard at it but is beaten on the under-edge, 138.9kph. Nine off the over but it was a very good one from Madhwal
Muscles it and pierces the off-side heavy field. Full and wide again, Omarzai is deep in the crease, goes on his back knee and smokes it through cover-point
Sprays it well wide outside off again, leaves it be. Passes outside the tramline
Goes for the yorker outside off, Shashank can only dig it out to the left of the bowler, who gets to it but doesn't throw
Full and in the slot outside off, Omarzai can only drill it to long-off
Goes wide again, but Omarzai stays still and leaves it be
Full and wide outside off, dug out through cover
Spears it full and wide outside off, just outside the tramline, but Shashank moves across for the scoop and it goes between his legs
Maphaka goes full, Omarzai punishes him again. He leans into it and lofts it over extra cover to end another expensive over, 166 from it
MUSCLED over long-off! Made it look very easy. Offcutter angling away from him, Omarzai had the desired room, he freed his arms and flat-batted it over the mid-off fielder
Length ball on middle and leg, chops it down the track
Connects it well. Back of a length outside leg, Omarzai backs away, arches back and ramps it over the keeper. It is the slower one, so he has time to hop and execute the stroke
Direct hit and Shashank would have been a goner. Another slower one, full on leg, he waits, drills it to mid-off and sets off. The throw from Jurel off the mark
Full and wide outside off, he squeezes it to mid-off and hares to the other end, 116.6kph

Glorious hit! Doesn't travel as long as I'd imagined it to but that's enough for Shashank and PBKS. Full ball, in his slot around off, he goes back and across and has ample scope to get underneath it and send it sailing into the straight boundary, 18 off the over
Banged short and slanting away, pulled to deep midwicket
Full and wide outside off, driven to deep cover

Oh superbly done, splits the gap perfectly. Angling away on a length outside off, Shashank stays legside of the ball in order to just steer it between backward point and short third. It was the offcutter, and that allowed him extra time
Length ball slanting away from off, he looks to get across and scoop it away but toe-ends it through midwicket for a brace
Shashank thrashes the length ball that is going away from him past backward point. Once again he stays deep in the crease and uses whatever was on offer
Straight to deep cover! End of a fine knock from Wadhera. This is bowled full and wide outside off, 141.5kph, he looks to get under it and go over cover but finds Hetmyer to perfection
Does it go the distance? It does, just about. Bumper from around the wicket, angling into Wadhera. He pulls, not in complete control but enough to split deep square leg and deep midwicket and go over
Length ball outside off, he stands tall and slashes it to deep cover
Smarrrt! Shashank knows what's coming. He quickly moves across to the off side and scoops the very full ball over short fine leg, fifty partnership up
Full again outside off, he slashes hard and gets it towards deep point
Very full and wide outside off, Wadhera cannot make contact
Slower bouncer outside off, Shashank is done in by the lack of pace and misses the ramp, just 119.9kph, superb over from Deshpande
Spears in a full and straight ball on middle, he digs it out to the on side and sprints to the other end. Deshpande charges at the ball but bumps into Shashank, who was running to the other end

Digs it in but slows it down, Wadhera arches back to play the ramp but misses. Oh, it is called wide for height. Samson checks with deep point and at the last second opts for the review. Turns out it wouldn't have passed over his head, had he stood straight, so the wide call has been reversed. The TV umpire also checks for the caught behind, nothing on Snicko
Low full toss on off, he can only hit it on the bounce to long-on

Goes for the yorker but dishes out a high full toss outside off, Wadhera is taken by surprise and only chops it towards cover. He signals for the review, not above the height of the waist, so it is a fair ball
Around the wicket, he spears a wide yorker, Wadhera can't dig it out
Quicker and angling away on a length, looks to whip it across but gets a leading edge towards point
Long-off leaps and it goes over. A bit of misjudgement from Jurel. Tossed up wide outside off, Shashank gets under it but didn't hit it as well as he would have liked
Inside edge as he looks to thump it across the line. Was in the slot and the shot was on
Slower through the air, on a length outside off, pats it away from cover
Fuller and wider outside off, he looks to drive inside out and hits it to cover
Fired on the pads, clipped through midwicket, 102.1kph
Once again full and wide outside off, left alone
Fires it very wide of the right-hander, he leaves it be
Full and slanting in on off, he comes forward and flicks it to wide long-on
Low full toss on off, wristed down to long-on
Wadhera continues his swinging spree! Once again he is prepared for the short ball, not afraid to pull it away since it is the shorter side. Carries well over deep square leg for a maximum

Oh my word, what placement that is from Wadhera. Madhwal bowls it short on leg, there is deep backward square leg in place. But Wadhera stands tall, whip-pulls it well away from the man in the deep to bring up a 25-ball fifty
Fuller on off and middle, driven down to long-on
Thrashed past backward point, excellent timing. Angling away on a length, Shashank reaches out and flat-bats the slash past the diving fielder in the ring
Fuller on off and middle, eased through midwicket
Dropped! Would have been a one-handed stunner. The wrong'un pushed wider outside off, Wadhera reaches out and ends up chipping it back
Fuller on leg, turns it through midwicket with soft hands and calls for two
Slogs it high and long! Nonchalant. Floated full on middle, Wadhera gets down on a knee and sends it sailing over deep forward square leg
Fuller on middle, whipped through midwicket
A wild go but Shashank's fortunate. He dances down to go hard at the googly, completely beaten in the air and gets a thick inside edge to short fine leg
Flatter and on a length outside off, he moves across and punches it to long-on
Flatter and on a length on middle, clipped through wide mid-on
Tossed up full outside off, driven down to long-off to get going

Parag has the last laugh! A wicket out of nowhere this. Tossed up outside off, wider line this time. Iyer has to reach out to it, yet goes hard at it. Ends up slicing it high in the air. A lot of time for Jaiswal to settle under it and pouch it at long-off. Just when Iyer was starting to look dangerous...
Slogged wide of long-on. Quicker one on off, in the slot for Iyer, who clears his front leg and thumps it all along the ground
Quicker and flatter, angled across, he misses the cut
Tucks this length ball through midwicket for a brace
Goes all the way down the ground! Flighted full, drifting to pitch around off, Wadhera lofts it straight back over the bowler. Gorgeous shot
On a length on middle, punched to the cover fielder
Full on leg, Iyer sweeps this on the bounce to deep square leg's right

On a length around middle and leg, Iyer goes back to work it leg side and misses the flick. Goes off his pads towards square leg. Hasaranga goes up in appeal, Samson is not so convinced and they don't review. This was going down leg
Floated full outside off, Iyer runs it fine on the off side but it goes straight to the short third fielder
Short of good length outside off, Iyer Swings it down the ground on the bounce to long-on's right
Thrashed through cover! Overpitched outside off and Iyer laces it to cover's left. The fielder's dive is in vain as Iyer takes full toll of this slower ball
Back of length outside off, Iyer dabs it to the short third fielder
Short of length outside off, Iyer opens the face to steer it to short third's left, but not fine enough of the fielder

Almost a chance! This is short on leg and going across, Iyer swivels and pulls it very fine. It's to Deshpande's left at short fine leg and it drops just short of him and he can't get down in time to stop this either!
Full outside off, driven to mid-off's right for a quick run
Dropped a little short around leg again, this time it goes on with the angle. Wadhera brings out another pull, but it's quite square and close to the fielder in the deep
On a length around off and going across, pushed towards short cover
Another short-ish googly, another boundary for Wadhera! Almost a replay of the first ball of the over as he rocks back to hammer a pull in front of square
Tossed up full outside off, driven out to deep cover
Wrong'un again, fuller this time, Wadhera tucks it in front of square for a single
Starts off with a googly, but it's too short and Wadhera rocks back and pulls it out through midwicket! Welcomes Hasaranga with a boundary
Flatter and full around off, Wadhera drives it to deep cover's left for a single
Backs away, goes inside out, and gets the boundary! This is floated up on leg, Wadhera makes room and lofts it over cover!
Tossed up around leg, Iyer works it down the ground to long-on
Wadhera eases a full ball down to wide long-off
Flighted on a length around off, Shreyas steers it to backward point, where Suryavanshi misfields and allows a single
Floated full around off, driven down to long-off
Short of length around leg, runs it down to short third
Length ball outside off seams in, deceiving Wadhera who was looking to push it off side. It goes off the inside half towards square leg and they get a single
Hoicked into the stands! Short ball outside off sits up nicely for Wadhera to pull it square

On a length around leg, clipped to midwicket and they take a quick single. It was a risky one, and maybe Iyer wasn't quick enough, but a direct hit at the non-striker's end would have seen him back in the dugout! Thankfully for him, the throw is wide
Back of length around leg, tucked away through backward square leg and they easily get two
On a length around middle, steered to backward point
Around yorker length outside off, squeezed back to the bowler
Full outside off, Wadhera eases it to cover
On a length around leg, Iyer drops it square on the off side for a quick run
Latches onto that! Short around off, enough width for Shreyas to work with, and he cuts it away behind point, well to the left of the off side sweeper
Length ball around off, Shreyas again looks to work it behind point. gets an inside edge onto the ground and through to Samson
beats Shreyas with a length ball angled across! This pitches outside off and goes past the bat as Shreyas looks to run it fine on the off side
Reaches out and slices this over cover point! Full and wide, and he frees his arms and gets this over the infield
Short around middle and angling across, Wadhera goes for the pull but is beaten
Leading edge, but it's safe! Another length ball on the pads, Iyer looks to work it leg side and the leading edge goes to the off side, between cover and point
Length ball on off, seaming in and Iyer neatly clips this to midwicket's right, and it beats deep square leg running across to the boundary rope!
Full outside off, Iyer steers it out to backward point

This slides down leg and there are loud appeals for caught behind. Sanju Samson makes a polite enquiry and is convinced by Deshpande to take a review. This was a length ball going down leg that Prabhsimran looks to glance. And there's a spike as the ball goes past bat! Deshpande has the in-form Prabh strangled down leg!

Skies it and it's taken! Maphaka has his second IPL wicket! Looks to hit this back of length ball angled across him down the ground but just gets a top edge that goes high. Samson settles under it to his right and does the needful. Owen's IPL debut ends in a two-ball duck
Full around middle and leg, tapped to point for a single
Oh, what a shot! 140kph short ball on off gives Prabhsimran enough width to work with. He extends his arms and slaps it in front of point for a six!
Length ball angled across, cut to point
Four more! Expensive start for Maphaka! This is on a length around leg and Prabhsimran looks to glance it fine. But he's missed it and it's gone off his pads. Too fine for short fine leg
Slashed for four!. Back of length on off, 139kph, and Prabh hacks at it and it flies over in the region between the keeper and short third
Full around off, Owen punches it back to the bowler, who deflects it to mid-off

Deshpande gets his man straightaway, though! This is full around off and Priyansh looks to drive on the up, but ends up chipping it to mid-off's right and Hetmyer makes no mistake! Farooqi's drop costs them just two runs!
Dropped at short fine leg! It's full down leg, Arya flicks it fine, to Farooqi's right. The Afghan dives at full stretch, but can't hold it one-handed!
Another full-ish ball, closer to off stump this time, he steers it straight of backward point now
Lovely placement! Fuller side of good length outside off, hint of shape away, and Prabhsimran deftly steers it between backward point and short third
On a length around leg, clipped out to deep square leg
On a length outside off, shaping away, Arya drives it square to deep point
On a length around middle and angled across Prabhsimran, who taps it towards the gully region for a single
Low full toss around off and Prabhsimran flicks it wide of mid-on to join his opening partner in hitting the first ball he faces for four
Length ball outside off, seaming in, Priyansh tucks it square on the leg side for a single
Full around off, pushed back to the bowler
Runs right away! Farooqi strays too full and too straight and Priyansh clips it wide of the short fine leg fielder for the first boundary
Gets across the line and scoops it fine but too little too late for RR. PBKS win and it is one that will help them inch one step closer to a spot they haven't been in since 2014 - the playoffs
Puts it in the gap but too late in the day. Full and in the slot around off, Maphaka whips it over midwicket
Sprays it full and down leg, Prabh dives and stops it
Edged and gone! Jansen does not bother celebrating. Length ball angling away, Hasaranga clears his front leg to go over the off side but gets a thick outside edge. Prabhsimran takes it calmly

Throws his bat at it and finds deep backward point to perfection! There's the big blow for PBKS. Nothing shows it more than Ponting jumping up off his seat in the dugout. Jansen goes for the wide yorker again, misses the execution by not much. But it is a length than Jurel cannot do much with. Owen makes no mistake in the deep
Full on off, heaved to deep midwicket. RR not getting the big hits they need regularly. 200 up for RR
Very full and wide outside off, he can only hit it to long-off
Short ball outside off again, pulled through midwicket. They want Jurel on strike for the last over and charge back for two. Direct hit at the bowler's end would have been curtains for Jurel
Bouncer outside off, no pace for Dubey to work with. He is pretty early in his pull and misses completely. It was the knuckle ball again
Wide yorker outside off, he can only squeeze it towards extra cover

Poor ball from Arshdeep. Short and angling away from Jurel with no protection behind point on the off side. He hops and carves it over backward point to bring up his second half-century in IPL 2025. It was the knuckle ball
Full and wide outside off, he reaches out to push it to long-off
Short ball oytside off, it is the slower one, Dubey swishes but misses
Short ball outside off, he hops to slash but misses. Looks towards the leg ump, doesn't get anything in return. Omarzai's done tonight, RR need 30 off 12
Jurel keeps RR's hopes alive with another clean strike. Length ball outside off, he stays still, standing with an off-stump guard. Clears his front leg and wallops it over long-on
Short on leg, pulled to deep square leg
Over the wicket, on a length on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for two

Smart catch from Bartlett and Omarzai gets Hetmyer. Full ball on off, Hettie clears his front leg and looks to go downtown. Gets height and not much distance. Long-on runs to his right, keeps his eye on the ball and takes it safely, causing Iyer beyond the boundary to exult
Full and outside off, chipped just away from extra cover for a brace
Length ball on a length outside off, lofted inside out over cover for two, 14 from the over

Poor Prabhsimran can't get hand to that and Arshdeep's smartness goes to waste. He spots Jurel moving across off and fires it full and wide. Jurel misses it, the keeper misses it and it is given as five wides. Wonder if PBKS could have reviewed the wide.
Short ball outside off, slower one, he looks to pull but under-edges it towards the keeper
Clean strike! Length ball angling away from him, Jurel stays put and lofts it straight over long-on
Slower short ball outside off, he has to delay his short and pulls it to long-on
Hetmyer misses out! Slot ball just outside off, he goes hard at it but connects with only thin air. Arshdeep has his hands on his head as it was not too far from off, 132.3kph
Slower bouncer outside off, he goes back to ramp it away but misses. Not called wide and Hetmyer wants to have another look. All good, RR lose a review
Very fill on middle, he flicks it to deep midwicket, 11 from Omarzai's third over
Squeezes the yorker towards point for a quick one
Jurel finds the gap to perfection. Moves back and across to the length ball outside off, flat-bats it through midwicket, just beats the man in the deep to his left again
Low full toss on middle and leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Room given, Hetmyer puts it away. Length ball angling away from him, he punches it between mid-off an extra cover
Length ball on leg, defensively pushed back to the bowler
Lobbed up, very full outside off, hit straight to cover. Three dots after the six, just eight from the over
Slows it down, fuller around off, punched back to the bowler
Spins away from a length on off, cut to backward point

Pick-up heave over deep midwicket, Jurel continues to fight. Quickly goes onto the back foot seeing a slightly short ball around off. Connects well to take it into the deep midwicket stands and bring up RR's 150
Spinning in from a length on middle and leg, clipped through midwicket
Quicker one on middle, it skids on and hurries him as he is on the back foot to punch it away. Gets it through his legs via the inside edge
A misfield and a possible run-out chance goes abegging! Brar fires it down leg, Jurel sweeps it to short fine leg and sets off but is sent back. Chahal lets it through and they cross over
Goes back to the length ball and slashes it to backward point
Fuller around off, punched through cover-point
A bouncer from around the stumps! Hetmyer does not have the helmet on and steers it to short third

Knocked him over! Brar continues to impress. Darts in a length ball angling in on leg, looked like the arm ball. Parag thought he could go back and heave it over the on side but it did not turn. Skids past his inside edge to knock the leg pole back. Brar celebrates with a thigh-five
Quicker length ball on off, heaved off the back foot to wide long-on
Take that! Parag stands tall and sends it sailing into the deep midwicket stands. Slightly short and angling in, enough for him to get underneath it, 17 came from the over
Shortish and angling in on off, pulled through forward square leg
Length ball around off, pats it through midwicket with soft hands and hares back for two
Length ball outside off, heaved to deep midwicket
Length ball on middle, clipped to deep midwicket
No-look six, Jurel edition! Length ball angling in on leg, he stays still and whips it over deep midwicket
Fuller on off, comes forward to punch but does so off the inner half to long-on
Quicker and on a length on middle, grip and turn there as it goes off the leading edge towards backward point
Flatter on middle, wristed away through midwicket
Fuller on middle, he goes back to punch it down to long-on
Slightly short, and that is enough for Jurel to rock back and pull it away for four. He beats deep midwicket to his left, only by just. A boundary after nearly four overs
Flatter and quicker on off, he hangs back and defends
Slaps the length ball on the up through cover. Wadhera covers good ground to keep it to two
Length ball wide outside off, punched to deep cover
Angling in on middle on a length, clipped through forward square leg for two
Gets behind the length ball just outside off and defends it

Aerial route... doesn't come off for Samson! Omarzai strikes with his second ball. Samson made room, exposed his stumps and stood still. He saw the length ball and looked to chip it over mid-off but didn't time it well. Jansen has his eyes on the ball as he runs back to his left and hangs on. PBKS believe and are coming back
Length ball outside off, steered to short third
Looks to drive this full ball outside off and gets it off the edge towards short third. They take a quick run
On a length on the pads, he whips it away to deep midwicket's right but only gets a single
ON a length on leg, pushed back out towards extra cover
On a length around middle, clipped towards long-on. Another single
Flicks this away wide of long-on, and they sprint for one. Can't get a second
Legbreak, full around middle and off, driven out towards cover
Tossed full outside off, this time he gets it straighter down the ground to long-off
Full around off, pushed out to extra cover

Jaiswal does try to take on Brar and perishes! Brar has removed both of RR's left-handed openers! Full and wide from around the wicket, Jaiswal looks to go over long-off and gets it off the toe end. Mitch Owen runs to his right and grabs it reverse-cupped. Brar brings out the thigh-slap celebration as Jaiswal makes his way back.
Punches this full ballsquare on the off side, where the point fielder doesn't collect on the first go, allowing them to take a single
Floated full outside off, Samson backs away and chips it over the extra cover fielder and does well to run two as long-off runs across
On a length around off and spinning in, Jaiswal flicks it away through square leg and Jaiswal brings up a 24-ball 50! He is the leading run-scorer in IPL 2025 as of now
On a length around middle, Jaiswal flicks it away but can't quite get it in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket. They only get a single
Flatter and full around middle and off, Samson drives it out to long-off
Lofts this over cover now as Chahal goes full on leg. Gets it straight enough of the off side sweeper to give the batters time to run two

Clears a leapiong Jansen at long-on! Floated up full on middle, drifting into the stumps. Samson clears his front leg and goes downtown and gets just enough elevation on that! If Jansen isn't reaching it, it's too high for anyone!
Legbreak spins away sharply from a length outside off. Samson looks to hammer it away on the off side and gets an inside edge onto his pads
On a length on middle, Jaiswal goes back and whips it out to deep midwicket
Drives this full ball down to long-off
Full outside off, driven to short cover
Full outside off, Samson squeezes a single to long-off
Length ball spins in from outside off, Jaiswal goes back to tuck it away to deep midwicket's right
Floated full outside off, drifting in, Samson drives along the carpet to long-off
Full outside off, Jaiswal eases it to long-on
Length ball angled across him, Samson runs it down to the very fine short third fielder. Rajasthan Royals record their best ever powerplay score!
And Samson picks up his first boundary! This is a harmless back-of-length ball around leg and he glances it fine on the leg side. Nobody there to stop it so it races away
On a length around middle and off, punched to cover
Yorker on off, Jaiswal is able to clip it out to deep square leg

Another boundary! Jaiswal is on a roll here! This is full outside off and angling in and Jaiswal clears his front leg and swings this over midwicket. Doesn't middle it, but gets enough to clear the infield and get a one-bounce four
Jaiswal keeps going on his merry way! Length ball outside off and he cuts it past the backward point fielder, whose dive to his left is in vain
Samson eases this full ball outside off to cover

And there's the spinner making the difference! This is darted in full outside off, Jaiswal looks to go down the ground and gets a leading edge that loops up to mid-off. Suryavanshi falls for a 15-ball 40. He's set RR up well in the chase!
Hammered down the ground! In the arc and he clears his front leg and hits this too far from long-on
Edge goes for four! Suryavanshi looks to take on this ball on a length outside off and gets a thick edge that goes fine on the off side. Beats the keeper and short third as well
Fuller outside off, Jaiswal eases it to long-on. First run that has not been an extra or a boundary!
Good start from the spinner. On a length on off and going on with the angle from around the wicket. He looks to cut and misses
Back to back sixes! Dug in short outside off and Suryavanshi gets in the line of the ball and swivels to pull it away behind square!
Deposited into the stands over midwicket! Overpitched on off and Suryavanshi clears his front leg and swings it away!
On a length outside off, Suryavanshi pushes at it and it hits the inside half of the bat and goes to the bowler's left. Another slower ball from Arshdeep
137kph bouncer outside off, Suryavanshi ducks out of the way!
Banged in short outside off, he looks to back away and ramp but misses. Good slower bouncer from Arshdeep
Short outside off, Suryavanshi reaches above his shoulders to pull this over midwicket. Jansen from long-on was running across and slides to stop it but it was placed far away enough from him!
Jaiswal looks to steer this one past backward point as well, but can't beat the fielder. Only 12 runs this over!
Neatly played! Length ball angled across, and he steers it in the gap between short third and backward point! 50 up for RR! In just 2.5 overs!
Full outside off, Jaiswal drives to extra cover

Full outside off, driven to mid-on even as the ball comes off the inside half of the bat. But wait, there's a lot of confusion and Jaiswal could be run out! The throw from the fielder at the non-striker's end hits the stumps as Suryavanshi was wandering outside his crease but he had planted his bat. The ball deflects away and they went for the single before deciding against it and Jaiswal has to put in the dive at the striker's end. And replays show he has juuust made it back! The ball came high to Prabh who was quick to collect and take the bails off, but Jaiswal got in
Full outside off, and it's driven to cover's right again for another boundary! Not hit as hard, but the placement was good enough. A bit of a misfield, and PBKS keep leaking runs
Thrashed past cover! Full and wide and Jaiswal hammers a grounded drive to the fielder's right and it flies away!
Thwacked over cow corner! Jansen overpitches again and Suryavanshi takes full toll. There's that big bat swing and it goes all the way. 22 off the first over, 17 off the second!
On a length outside off, parried to mid-on
Slashed over slip! Full outside off, Jaiswal with that big backlift swings at it and gets a thick edge that flies over the slip fielder!
Short outside off, Suryavanshi fends towards point
And Suryavanshi joins in on the fun! Overpitched outside off and Suryavanshi lofts it down the ground for six!
Jansen slides this full ball down the leg side. Suryavanshi misses his flick and it's called wide
Back of length outside off, Suryavanshitucks it towards mid-on. He wanted a single, but it wasn't quite on offer

And now the edge flies for four! 22 runs off the first over! Jaiswal's early aggression meant there is no slip fielder, and this outswinger takes the edge and goes between keeper and short third. Great start for Jaiswal and Royals!
And we have the first six! This is overpitched around middle and leg and Jaiswal whips this over square leg!
